summary: A small non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, for extra detail or a quick choice that does not deserve a dialog: who must review, what a check does, branch info.
whenToUse: Explaining something next to the control it is about, when the text is too long for a tooltip or contains a link.
A small form or a couple of actions tied to one control.
Info icons: Popover (click or openOnHover) instead of Tooltip, so touch and screen reader users can reach it.
whenNotToUse: A list of actions: use Menu, which has the right keyboard model.
A label for an icon button: use Tooltip.
A task that must be completed or cancelled: use Dialog.

dos.title: Keep it short and anchored
dos.text: A title, two sentences, at most one or two actions. The arrow shows what it belongs to.

donts.title: Forms that span several sections
donts.text: A popover closes on an outside click, so long input gets lost. Use a Dialog or a Drawer.

accessibility: Base UI Popover: the trigger exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls; the popup is a dialog named by its title.
Focus moves into the popup when it opens and back to the trigger when it closes. Escape and outside clicks close it.
Non-modal by default: the page stays usable. Set modal when the popover holds a small form.
It flips and shifts to stay in the viewport; the arrow follows the anchor.
contentGuidelines: Title in sentence case, no period. Body in one or two plain sentences.
Links inside say where they go.
